# Input Event

The `"input"` event happens when a user changes the value of an input element. Use it with `addEventListener()` when you want the page to update while the user types, moves a slider, or changes a control.
name: Input Event
tips:
- Write `"input"` in quotation marks inside `addEventListener()`.
- Use the `"input"` event when the page should respond as a value changes.
- The function after `"input"` is the event handler. It runs when the input changes.
- Make sure the input element has been selected before adding an input event to it.
- In Web Lab, `"input"` often appears with sliders, text fields, and controls that update the page immediately.
